issue.title: Serial connection at 100% CPU

comments.body: @bertbuchholz , can you please try adding `O_NDELAY` instead of `O_NONBLOCK` [here](https://github.com/dronecore/DroneCore/blob/develop/core/serial_connection.cpp#L69) ?
I just realized, the reason it's still not blocking is that VMIN and VTIME for the termios settings are both zero. I don't know enough about this stuff to change this sensibly.
@bertbuchholz you are right, thanks for checking this. I've added a commit to fix `VMIN`.
@bertbuchholz I've merged this to `develop`. Please test again and re-open if you still have the issue. Thanks for the quick responses here.
Yes, the VMIN setting does it, thanks for the fast fix!

issue.title: core: do blocking read on serial port

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
We should be able to read in a blocking way on the serial port since it
happens on a separate thread.

Fixes #176.
